assets.RibbonFlow.png:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production game-engine Ribbon particle RGBA texture, a single flat texture map.
Primary request: a lively flowing energy trail made of layered wispy white filaments, fine turbulent streaks, translucent silky curls and tiny elongated embers.
Composition: exactly 1536 by 512 pixels, horizontal landscape 3:1 canvas. U runs left to right along the trail, V across its width. The newest head is on the LEFT: full bright braided flowing strands beginning near x=2%, concentrated around y=50%, and flowing right into a long progressively thinner and fainter tail that dissolves completely before x=98%. Use almost the full width. Organic sine-like longitudinal motion, subtle variation in thickness and negative space between overlapping wisps. Keep the main shape in the middle 65% of the height, with soft tendrils and 12% completely transparent space along the top and bottom. The left end is smoothly rounded and feathered; no cut-off vertical stripe. It must remain readable when the texture is stretched 5x horizontally on a moving 3D ribbon.
Color palette: neutral white and silver only, no hue, enabling runtime particle tint. Bright white filament centers, semitransparent soft white glow edges.
Background: true RGBA transparency, transparent pixels around every filament, graded alpha glow.
Constraints: ONLY one texture, NOT a rendered scene or presentation. No words, no border, no labels, no watermark, no checkerboard pixels, no black/gray/colored background, no floor shadow, no 3D perspective, no endpoint starburst, no separate isolated object. Preserve actual transparency.
assets.BeamArc.png:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production game-engine Beam particle RGBA texture, a single flat texture map.
Primary request: a lively high-energy electrical beam with a strong narrow white-hot horizontal core and delicate branching lightning arcs and threads that weave around and reconnect to the core, subtle turbulent plasma eddies and small sharp sparking accents.
Composition: exactly 1536 by 512 pixels, horizontal landscape 3:1 canvas. U runs left to right along the beam, V across its width. Core is horizontally centered at y=50%, extends from x=2% to x=98%, and remains continuous and bright across its length, with subtle jagged energy variation. Both tips gently taper in the outermost 4% and end in transparency, NO spherical head and NO giant starbursts. Fine branching electricity stays within the central 65% of the image height; leave 12% completely transparent top and bottom padding. Multiple thin distinct arcs instead of a solid thick white band. Balanced energy all along its length. Texture must remain readable when stretched 5x horizontally on a 3D beam.
Color palette: neutral white and silver only, no hue, for runtime particle tint. Opaque bright filament centers and smoothly feathered semitransparent white glow edges.
Background: true RGBA transparency; all empty space transparent, soft glow encoded in alpha.
Constraints: ONLY one flat texture. No words, no border, no labels, no watermark, no checkerboard pixels, no black/gray/colored background, no scene, no floor shadow, no 3D perspective. Preserve actual transparency.
